capabilities.title: Validate and store a caller-supplied scoped capture envelope in DPAPI
capabilities.note: LOCAL_ONLY: import validates a caller-supplied envelope and stores scoped credentials through ProtectedStore; it does not independently establish browser-capture provenance or account ownership. This is not live evidence and must never be reported as recorded_live. Current CDP Network.enable failures prevented capture, so the importer has not been used. See verification/remaining-elevenlabs-2026-10-16/evidence.json.
